description: A close-to-the-source English retelling of the folktale, keeping the brisk oral cadence, repeated Thursday trials, and traditional motif-magic (the one-eyed hag bargains, the pocket-ship, and the toast-pouring reveal) while preserving the tale’s blunt humor and justice.
tone: Classic folktale; brisk, wry, and adventurous with dark comic justice.
summary: A ragged boy named Littlecourt outwits trolls and a cowardly knight to win a princess and half a kingdom—then rescues her sister from the sea-bottom lair.
